paragraphs.text: Avatar is a creature type used for beings which are an aspect, projection, or embodiment of a larger power or concept. Avatars are powerful beings that exist throughout the Multiverse . They typically embody a power or concept larger than themselves. These can include emotions ( Avatar of Fury ), virtues ( Avatar of the Resolute ), creature types ( Arahbo, the First Fang ), gods ( Titania, Gaea Incarnate ), planes ( Soul of Ravnica ), and even other avatars ( Scion of the Ur-Dragon ).
The subtype has also been used for some Universes Beyond characters.
Avatars appear across all five colors .
Avatar is one of the original creature types from Alpha and is still in regular use. The subtype first appeared on the card Personal Incarnation ( Alpha ).
They tend toward higher mana values , with only 5 costing less than three mana. Most are rare or mythic rare .
Avatars have appeared in cycles in many sets.

Progenitor avatars such as Arahbo and Ur-Dragon make up the primordial essence of their respective creature types. They are not known to hail from a specific plane but might travel between them. The Ur-Sphinx is an alternate version of the Ur-Dragon in the Echoverse .

The Archaics ( 29 cards ) of Arcavios are a race of wise, giant, long-lived beings with an innate talent for magic. They can be seen striding through the Vastlands, exploring sources of magic with their many arms, or contemplating existence through their "eye", which is a magical focus of some kind. Archaics can live for thousands of years; many are thought to have been alive since the Dawning Age. Mages seek out Archaics for their vast knowledge of history and magic, but Archaics tend to communicate in obscure allusions and cryptic metaphors.
During the Oriq Attack on Strixhaven , Extus Narr summoned a creature from the Blood Age known as the Blood Avatar . The avatar's only purpose was to unmake what had stood for centuries

Otarian barbarian Jeska was cursed by the Cabal Patriarch inadvertently turning her into the avatar Phage the Untouchable . Later, when facing Akroma in the Grand Coliseum , Kamhal tried to stop the duel by slaying both participants with Soul Reaper . Unfortunately, Zagorka tried to intervene at the same time, leading Phage, Akroma, and Zagorka to all be slain by the attack. This event led to the aggregations of the three women and the Rebirth of Karona the manifestation of Dominarian mana .
Valgavoth created the five Overlords of Duskmourn to act as extensions of his will and act on his behalf. Each Overlord oversees one of the five zones of The House .
On Ixalan, avatars of the Threefold Sun manifest as dinosaurs. Each of the sun's three aspects has its own avatar, while a fourth avatar, Gishath , embodies all three aspects.

In the Seer's Parables , the origin of the world of Shadowmoor and various aspects of the world are attributed to the powerful spirit avatars to be found throughout the plane's history. According to Mark Rosewater , these creatures might have been given the God or Demigod subtype instead, had those subtypes existed at the time.
Kaldra was an avatar created by the unification of the Kaldra artifacts. When Glissa assembled these artifacts to dispatch Memnarch , he took control of the avatar and turned it against her.
After being resurrected as part of Operation Desperation during War of the Spark , Niv-Mizzet became a dragon avatar as the new Living Guildpact of Ravnica.
Three nonlegendary Avatars are known to be on Zendikar : the embodiment of encroaching death , the natural erosion of reality and a human capable of reaching an enlightened state .
Marvel's Spider-Man featured Spider-Byte as an avatar, but in the sense as they represent another character in a virtual world.
Avatar: The Last Airbender uses the avatar creature type for the titular Avatar Aang and his predecessors.

In Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles , the creature type is used primarily for the Four Winds and members of the Pantheon . Despite depicting specific characters, Manmoth, Cudley, and each member of the Four Winds received a non-legendary card; this may have been done to reduce the number of legendary creatures in the set.
